entries.title: II Chronicles 12:1
segments: And it happened when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had made himself strong, he departed from the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:2
segments: And it happened in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had sinned against the LORD

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:3
segments: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. And the people who came with him out of Egypt [were] without number: Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:4
segments: And he took the fortified cities in Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:5
segments: And Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam, and [to] the rulers of Judah who were gathered to Jerusalem because of Shishak. And [he] said to them, So says the LORD, You have forsaken Me, and therefore I also have left you in the hand of Shishak.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:6
segments: And the rulers of Israel and the king humbled themselves. And they said, The LORD [is] righteous.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:7
segments: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will give them some deliverance. And My wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:8
segments: But they shall be his servants, so that they may know My service, and the service of the kings of the countries.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:9
segments: And Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house. He took all. And he carried away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:10
segments: In place of these king Rehoboam made shields of bronze, and gave [them] into the hands of the chief of the guard who kept the entrance of the king's house.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:11
segments: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and carried them and brought them again into the guardroom.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:12
segments: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him so that He would not destroy [him] altogether. And also things went well in Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:13
segments: And king Rehoboam strengthened himself at Jerusalem, and reigned. For Rehoboam [was] forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put His name there. And his mother's name [was] Naamah the Ammonitess.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:14
segments: And he did the evil because he did not prepare his heart to seek the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:15
segments: And the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, [are] they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And the wars of Rehoboam and Jeroboam [lasted] all their days.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:16
segments: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David. And his son Abijah reigned in his place.
